import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

SP="MVDCQKEACNLQSCIQRNQYNQGNCEKFVNDLLLCCKRWYDKNSLTGNEAPHTCPELKPLLRQLSSRNLT"
HS="MPQKDPCQKQACEIQKCLQANSYMESKCQAVIQELRKCCAQYPKGRSVVCSGFEKEEEENLTRKSASK"

B62="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ln=B62.strip().split("\n"); aas=ln[0].split()
M={(aas[i],aas[j]):int(ln[i+1].split()[j+1]) for i in range(20) for j in range(20)}

def nw(a,b,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); NEG=-1e9
    Mx=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    Tm=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int); Tx=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int); Ty=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int)
    Mx[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); Tx[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); Ty[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=M.get((a[i-1],b[j-1]),-2)
            c=[Mx[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]]; k=int(np.argmax(c)); Mx[i,j]=c[k]+s; Tm[i,j]=k
            c=[Mx[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge]; k=int(np.argmax(c)); Ix[i,j]=c[k]; Tx[i,j]=k
            c=[Mx[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge]; k=int(np.argmax(c)); Iy[i,j]=c[k]; Ty[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([Mx[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); A=[];Bb=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: st=2
        elif j==0: st=1
        if st==0: A.append(a[i-1]);Bb.append(b[j-1]);st=Tm[i,j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: A.append(a[i-1]);Bb.append("-");st=Tx[i,j];i-=1
        else: A.append("-");Bb.append(b[j-1]);st=Ty[i,j];j-=1
    return "".join(A[::-1]),"".join(Bb[::-1])

al_sp,al_hs=nw(SP,HS)
print("Alignment S. pombe cmc4 vs human CMC4 / p8MTCP1 (Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62, affine -11/-1):")
print("  Sp:",al_sp); print("  Hs:",al_hs)
ident=sum(1 for x,y in zip(al_sp,al_hs) if x==y and x!="-")
acol=sum(1 for x,y in zip(al_sp,al_hs) if x!="-" and y!="-")
print(f"  identity {ident}/{acol} = {100*ident/acol:.1f}% over aligned columns\n")

i=j=0; pairs=[]
for x,y in zip(al_sp,al_hs):
    if x!="-": i+=1
    if y!="-": j+=1
    if x=="C" and y=="C": pairs.append((i,j))
print("Cysteines aligned 1:1 (Sp resnum, Hs resnum):"); print("  ",pairs)
print(f"  {len(pairs)} aligned pairs; Sp has {SP.count('C')} Cys, Hs has {HS.count('C')} Cys\n")

hs_ss=[(7,38),(17,28),(39,50)]    # 1HP8 SSBOND, experimental NMR
sp_pred=[(4,35),(14,25),(36,54)]  # AF-G2TRJ8-F1-v6, SG-SG < 3.0 A
h2s={h:s for s,h in pairs}
print("="*78)
print("Register test: does each experimental human disulfide map onto a predicted cmc4 one?")
print("="*78)
spset=[tuple(sorted(p)) for p in sp_pred]; rows=[]
for a,b in hs_ss:
    ma,mb=h2s.get(a),h2s.get(b)
    mapped=tuple(sorted((ma,mb))) if (ma and mb) else None
    rows.append(dict(human_1HP8_SSBOND=f"C{a}-C{b}",
                     aligned_cmc4_pair=f"C{ma}-C{mb}" if mapped else "unmapped",
                     predicted_in_cmc4_model="YES" if mapped in spset else "NO"))
reg=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(reg.to_string(index=False))
free_hs=sorted(set(p[1] for p in pairs)-{c for ss in hs_ss for c in ss})
free_sp=sorted(set(p[0] for p in pairs)-{c for ss in sp_pred for c in ss})
print(f"\n  Unpaired Cys, human (1HP8 experimental): {['C%d'%c for c in free_hs]}")
print(f"  Unpaired Cys, cmc4 (AlphaFold predicted): {['C%d'%c for c in free_sp]}")
same = bool(free_sp and free_hs and h2s.get(free_hs[0])==free_sp[0])
print(f"  Same aligned column? {same}")
n=int((reg.predicted_in_cmc4_model=='YES').sum())
print(f"\n  RESULT: {n}/3 experimental disulfides reproduced in exact register in the cmc4 model.")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12.5,4.4))
def draw(seq,y,label,ss,free,col):
    for k,aa in enumerate(seq):
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((k,y),1,.8,fc="#b2182b" if aa=="C" else "#ededed",ec="w",lw=.4))
    ax.text(-1.5,y+.4,label,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9.5)
    for (a,b) in ss:
        ax.plot([a-.5,(a+b)/2-.5,b-.5],[y+.85,y+1.55,y+.85],color=col,lw=1.8)
    for c in free: ax.plot(c-.5,y-.3,marker="v",color="#f1a340",ms=10,mec="k",mew=.5)
draw(SP,0,"S. pombe cmc4\nAlphaFold predicted",sp_pred,free_sp,"#2166ac")
draw(HS,-3.2,"H. sapiens CMC4 / p8MTCP1\n1HP8 experimental SSBOND",hs_ss,free_hs,"#1a9850")
for s,h in pairs: ax.plot([s-.5,h-.5],[-.2,-2.45],color="#aaaaaa",lw=.7,ls=":")
ax.set_xlim(-18,78); ax.set_ylim(-4.1,2.2); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("All three experimental human CMC4 disulfides are reproduced in the S. pombe cmc4 model in exact register.\n"
             "The unpaired thiol (orange) sits at the same aligned position in both.",fontsize=10.5)
ax.text(60,1.2,"blue/green = disulfide\norange = free thiol\nred = cysteine\ndotted = aligned Cys",
        fontsize=8.5,bbox=dict(fc="w",ec="#999999"))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
reg.to_csv("table_disulfide_register.csv",index=False)
print("\n  wrote table_disulfide_register.csv")
